# Refreshify

> Refreshify is a free, open-source (MIT) Windows maintenance app by Luka Stojiljković. It cleans up, repairs and updates a PC with the tools Windows already has (DISM, SFC, chkdsk, Windows Update, Microsoft Defender and winget), in one native Windows 11 app without terminal windows. It creates a System Restore point first, runs tools in an order that avoids known failures, and recognizes and fixes 15 common failures.

Key facts:

- 27 tools in five categories: Cleanup, Repair, Network, Updates & security, and Troubleshooting. "Run all" runs 16 of them by default.
- Requires Windows 11, or Windows 10 version 1809 or later, x64. Tested on Windows 11 25H2. English UI; problem detection works in every Windows language.
- Tools that need administrator rights run in an elevated helper, so Windows asks for approval once per session.
- "Get help" builds a report about a failed step to paste into an AI assistant, with personal details hidden by default.
- Collects no data. Its only network request is a daily update check against GitHub, which can be turned off. The Windows tools it runs connect to Microsoft and app publishers as they normally do.
- Verified by 209 unit tests, UI Automation on Windows 11 and a silent install and uninstall in CI.
